title: Reset affects only the requesting session

context.hint: Review isolation of default event identifiers and audit-chain state on a shared tool server.
context.surface: A tool server can serve several client sessions in one process. Event logging assigns default session identifiers and links events to prior events.
assumptions: Multiple client sessions can share one server process.
Tests can use in-memory client and server streams with synthetic events.

review.invariant: A reset changes only the calling session's default event state. Explicit identifiers continue to follow the public contract.
review.verification: Verify that a reset in one fixture session leaves another session's chain intact. Run the ordinary tool-server tests and the isolation checks against an independent copy of the repaired code.

source_observation.summary: Isolation regressions failed on the original copy and passed on the repaired copy alongside the normal tool-server suite. The transport check used in-memory streams. Remote session teardown and state eviction remained unverified.
